conditions.fixture: same existing demo seed; komorebi 60 products; same staff identity; newly authenticated cookie in each isolated runtime
conditions.sampleAllocation: before Chromium 3; after Chromium 3 and WebKit 3; same seed baseTime; APIRequestContext reads complete response body
conditions.workerState: fresh independent runtime per test case; sequential GETs in each size sample case; these are size observations, not cold/warm latency samples

sizeDefinition.htmlBytes: UTF-8 bytes of full HTTP response body, uncompressed
sizeDefinition.hydrationScriptBodyBytes: UTF-8 bytes of router hydration inline script bodies, selected by data-tsr-stream-part or $_TSR / $R[tsr]; includes serialized router/query state plus router/Seroval bootstrap and stream cleanup; excludes script tags; not standalone dehydrated JSON
sizeDefinition.gzipBytes: Node gzipSync level 6 computed on sampled body/script source; not observed wire compression or transfer bytes
sizeDefinition.limits: No TTFB/FCP/latency claim. Chromium-to-Chromium comparison only; after WebKit is an additional size observation.
